description: This file defines a LineReporter class for test reporting in Playwright, extending TerminalReporter to handle test output, progress, and errors with TTY support.

classes.name: LineReporter
classes.description: A class extending TerminalReporter to provide line-based test reporting with TTY support.

methods.name: onBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test suite, outputs starting message.

methods.name: _dumpToStdio
methods.description: Outputs test chunks to the appropriate stream, with headers for new tests.

methods.name: onTestBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test case.

methods.name: onStepBegin
methods.description: Handles the start of a test step.

methods.name: onStepEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: Handles pausing during a test, waits for user input.

methods.name: onTestEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of a test case, outputs failure info if needed.

methods.name: _updateLine
methods.description: Updates the current test line display.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Handles the end of the test suite, outputs final epilogue.
